title: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subjec
question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group, the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all courses in that department, and the full name and school name of the department, considering only departments that grant degrees, have a non-null department full name, and are not the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
    tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED,
    tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED,
    MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso
    ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = '928034000' OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5)
    AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
),
department_cip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS CIP_VARIANCE,
    STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS CIP_STDDEV
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18'
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  b.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
  b.TIP_TERM_CODE,
  b.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED,
  b.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED,
  b.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED,
  dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  dcs.CIP_VARIANCE,
  dcs.CIP_STDDEV,
  dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  dcs.SCHOOL_NAME

`MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6'), kevin_courses AS (SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, td.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, td.num_subjects, td.avg_enrollment, kc.FULL_NAME, kc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, kc.STUDENT_YEAR, kc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, kc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, kc.COURSE_LEVEL, kc.window_column, WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptTotalEnrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, MAX(scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20), DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, dte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptTotalEnrolled AS dte JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS dme ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, inner_cte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_enrolled_students DESC, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic.STUDENT_YEAR, ic.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_student_years, s1.STUDENT_YEAR, s1.num_students, s1.avg_students_per_year, s1.range_students_per_year, s1.var_students_per_year, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_student_years, NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR, NULL AS num_students, NULL AS avg_students_per_year, NULL AS range_students_per_year, NULL AS var_students_per_year, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, STUDENT_YEAR

WITH student_info AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), student_info_with_admin AS (SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_info AS si LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), school_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_units) AS school_avg_units, VARIANCE(ic.avg_units) AS school_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT d.SCHOOL_CODE IN (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7') GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.school_avg_units, sus.school_units_variance FROM student_info_with_admin AS s LEFT JOIN school_units_stats AS sus ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = sus.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_num_enrolled_students, m.min_academic_year, m.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS c JOIN MathTermStats AS m ON c.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
    tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED,
    tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED,
    MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso
    ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = '928034000' OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5)
    AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
),
department_cip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS CIP_VARIANCE,
    STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS CIP_STDDEV
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18'
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
  b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  b.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  b.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
  b.TIP_TERM_CODE,
  b.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED,

  dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  dcs.CIP_VARIANCE,
  dcs.CIP_STDDEV,
  dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  dcs.SCHOOL_NAME
FROM base AS b
JOIN department_cip_stats AS dcs

  l.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  l.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_CODE,
  l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID),
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  VAR_SAMP(cd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE),
  STDDEV(cd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE),
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t
  ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT
WHERE (l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = '928034000' OR t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5)
  AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
  AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18'
